channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about David Blatt | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about David Blatt from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mindaugas Kuzminskas on David Blatt
item.description:
Mindaugas Kuzminskas on Blatt's open letter:

“I think he did a right move. There was a lot of speculation on his situation. I hope it's gonna be an example for everyone how to fight the problems and encourage others to follow the same path.”

Mindaugas Kuzminskas on David Blatt, Aug 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @Urbodo.

item.title: Rimas Kurtinaitis on David Blatt, Sarunas Jasikevicius
item.description:
Rimas Kurtinaitis:

“We have David Blatt’s example, of course. He did a great job in Cleveland, but the club still wasn’t satisfied for some reason. Probably because he tried to enforce discipline on the team. How do you enforce the rules with these millionaires in the NBA anyway? I don’t think Sarunas Jasikevicius needs to jump into a head coaching job in the NBA right away. He’s a very talented, smart, promising coach, but first he should test the water and gain some experience in American basketball.”

Rimas Kurtinaitis on David Blatt, Sarunas Jasikevicius, May 9, 2019. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: David Blumenthal on David Blatt
item.description:
“I can’t imagine that (Blatt) would go in and rub people the wrong way. And if he did, it’s unfortunate because players need to be more responsible for themselves and be grown-ups,”

David Blumenthal on David Blatt, May 8, 2016. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on David Blatt
item.description:
“I thought Coach Blatt did a great and phenomenal job here. He taught me a lot. Just being friends with him and getting a chance to understand him was great for me. I know a lot of guys around here, we talked about it the other day, they miss him and his presence. I would just like keep in contact with him. Hopefully, he gets another job in this league because he deserves it.”

Tyronn Lue on David Blatt, Apr 28, 2016. Source: Akron Beacon Journal.

item.title: Raanan Katz on LeBron James, David Blatt
item.description:
Miami Heat minority owner Raanan Katz:

“David Blatt's main problem was LeBron's attitude. I sat court-side during all the games Cleveland played in Miami, I was a few feet away from the Cavaliers' bench, and I heard everything. There was no dialogue between Blatt and LeBron. Blatt would talk to Timofey Mozgov and the other guys. LeBron takes advantage of being an NBA superstar, and he needs to realize that it won't work. Everyone saw how the Golden State Warriors beat LeBron and the Cavaliers a week ago. He has to understand that to win, the entire team has to be in sync.”

Raanan Katz on LeBron James, David Blatt, Jan 26, 2016. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Raanan Katz on LeBron James, David Blatt
item.description:
Miami Heat minority owner Raanan Katz:

“I spoke to David Blatt while he was here in Miami when the Heat played the Cleveland Cavaliers. He didn't see it coming, but I could tell the situation wasn't 100 percent working. I thought LeBron James had enough brains to make it work, though.”

Raanan Katz on LeBron James, David Blatt, Jan 26, 2016. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on David Blatt
item.description:
“It’s just hard in our league to see somebody who has had that much sucess, that’s done that well, that’s that well-respected, not just among coaches but the whole basketball world has great respect for David Blatt,”

Mike Budenholzer on David Blatt, Jan 24, 2016. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: LeBron James on David Blatt
item.description:
Chris Haynes:LeBron James on people thinking he influenced Blatt's ouster:

“I can't get caught up in worrying about what other people think.”

LeBron James on David Blatt, Jan 23, 2016. Source: Twitter @ChrisBHaynes.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on David Blatt
item.description:
“It's just bizarre. ... It just leaves you with a bit of an empty feeling, because Blatt's a great guy, and he did a great job there.”

Rick Carlisle on David Blatt, Jan 23, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on David Blatt
item.description:
But prior to Saturday's contest against division rival Chicago Bulls,Lue said his predecessor, David Blatt, deserves to coach the All-Star Game after leading the team to a conference leading 30-11 record.

“I talked to P.J. Carlesimo about it this morning and I told him I think Coach Blatt should coach it,”

Tyronn Lue on David Blatt, Jan 23, 2016. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on David Blatt
item.description:
Chris Haynes:Tyronn Lue said he got 716 text messages.

“It was a good day for me, but a bad day for Blatt.”

Tyronn Lue on David Blatt, Jan 23, 2016. Source: Twitter @ChrisBHaynes.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on David Blatt
item.description:
“The NBA has been trying to work around some different things for the All-Star Game and he's done a great job here. We're first in the East and I think it would be sweet if Coach Blatt could coach the All-Star Game one last time.”

Tyronn Lue on David Blatt, Jan 23, 2016. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Brad Stevens on David Blatt
item.description:
Sean Grande:Brad Stevens:

“The play we ran for Avery Bradley's 3 in Dallas.. I stole that from David Blatt. The way he coached for a year and half speaks for itself.”

Brad Stevens on David Blatt, Jan 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @SeanGrandePBP.

item.title: Brendan Haywood on David Blatt
item.description:
He shared his thoughts on the Cavs’ dramatic move in an interview on Sirius XM’s NBA Today channel.

“From what I was hearing, David Blatt kind of lost the team,”

Brendan Haywood on David Blatt, Jan 22, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Brendan Haywood on David Blatt
item.description:
“I remember last year telling somebody on the team, ‘I love David Blatt. But if we’re in a close game, he can’t help us,’”

Brendan Haywood on David Blatt, Jan 22, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Brendan Haywood on LeBron James, David Blatt
item.description:
Haywood said on Sirius XM.

“That’s not a shot at Blatt. But … David Blatt can’t come to a huddle and draw up a play that would get us a good shot. David Blatt doesn’t understand sometimes substitution patterns. The mistake he made against the Bulls when he didn’t have the ball in LeBron’s hands at the end of the game… There were obvious mistakes he was making, and you start to see it as a player, where ‘We’re going to have to win this on our own, because he can’t do for us what Gregg Popovich can do for the Spurs. He can’t take advantage of a mismatch the way Steve Kerr did in the NBA Finals – Steve Kerr made it so it was hard for us to play James Jones. They attacked him every time he was in the game.”

Brendan Haywood on LeBron James, David Blatt, Jan 22, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Dwane Casey on David Blatt
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Dwane Casey on David Blatt firing:

“He's a friend. I don't know what's going on [in Cleveland] but you always hate to see a fellow coach lose his job”

Dwane Casey on David Blatt, Jan 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on David Blatt
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:JB Bickerstaff on fired Cavs coach David Blatt:

“It's tough but I think he's done enough to prove that he can work in this league.”

JB Bickerstaff on David Blatt, Jan 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.

item.title: Scott Skiles on David Blatt
item.description:
Magic coachScott Skiles on David Blatt:

“Back in my day, you use to have to at least lose games before you got fired.”

Scott Skiles on David Blatt, Jan 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @MagicInsider.

item.title: Scott Skiles on David Blatt
item.description:
John Denton:Scott Skiles on David Blatt firing:

“Nowadays, you can be Coach of the Year and get fired. It’s just the way things have gone in my profession.”

Scott Skiles on David Blatt, Jan 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @JohnDenton555.

item.title: Steve Kerr on David Blatt
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Steve Kerr on David Blatt being fired by #Cavaliers:

“It's a tough business when you go 30-11 and you get fired.”

Steve Kerr on David Blatt, Jan 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Brendan Haywood on LeBron James, David Blatt
item.description:
“But Blatt has to make sure he makes some decisions in front of LeBron on his own so he doesn't lose the rest of the team. Hopefully, LeBron knows he has to be a certain way so that the rest of the team will still buy into what Blatt is telling them. I think it can work. LeBron is doing a pretty good job of keeping the noise down. He knows what he wants around him, he knows how he wants to play and he's about the right things.”

Brendan Haywood on LeBron James, David Blatt, Nov 4, 2015. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: David Griffin on David Blatt
item.description:
Chris Fedor:Griffin on Blatt:

“I don't know what we're really critiquing at this point. Ownership will look at all of us and we will try to get better.”

David Griffin on David Blatt, Jun 18, 2015. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: David Griffin on David Blatt
item.description:
Jeff Zillgitt:Cavs GM David Griffin:

“One things David (Blatt) did as well as anybody - and I wish I did better - was ignore the noise.”

David Griffin on David Blatt, Jun 18, 2015. Source: Twitter @JeffZillgitt.

item.title: LeBron James on David Blatt
item.description:
Now the Cavaliers are four victories away from ending a 51-year professional championship drought in the city, and Blatt is a huge part of that.

“They wanted Coach Blatt fired, saying we needed another point guard, will LeBron and Kyrie be able to play together? So many story lines was just happening at that point in time,”

LeBron James on David Blatt, May 27, 2015. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: LeBron James on David Blatt
item.description:
Royce Young:LeBron on Lue stopping Blatt calling TO:

“That's why we're a unit, that's why we're a team. Players make mistakes, coaches make mistakes.”

LeBron James on David Blatt, May 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @CBSSportsNBA.

item.title: Kevin Love on David Blatt
item.description:
Love said Wednesday morning.

“Coach (David Blatt) had approached me. I was playing heavy minutes and he came to me and asked if I'd sit a game or two and that's all it was.”

Kevin Love on David Blatt, Mar 18, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: LeBron James on David Blatt
item.description:
James said after the game.

“It was a referee that was away from the play [who called it]. I was talking to Eric Lewis, one of the other refs, and Coach Blatt was getting a little fired up about it, too, and he was on his way to a technical. So I just got him up out of the way before he got a T. So, just protecting my coach.”

LeBron James on David Blatt, Jan 14, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: David Griffin on David Blatt
item.description:
Griffin told reporters on Sunday.

“It's a non-story, it's a non-narrative. Coach Blatt is our coach, he's going to remain our coach. Do not write that as a vote of confidence. He never needed one. It was never a question. So don't write it that way.”

David Griffin on David Blatt, Jan 4, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on David Blatt
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Rick Carlisle:

“David Blatt is one of the best coaches in the world. He proved that long before he ever got to the NBA.”

Rick Carlisle on David Blatt, Jan 4, 2015. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.
